long: Agentcard gives every user of your product a payment-card wallet their AI agent can spend from. Cards are added once, and purchases come out priced, approved and paid within limits.
The company cites B2B use, such as storing corporate cards and automating purchases through a Slack agent. Pricing is usage-based.
agentcard.who: Products that want their users' agents to make purchases safely.

long: Aident AI is a unified capability layer that connects any AI agent to 1,000+ apps, 27,000+ actions and 400+ expert-built skills through one reusable setup.
It aims to let agents act across tools while keeping every action under control. It is listed as freemium.
aident-ai.who: Teams who want agents to act across many apps without per-app integration work.

long: Airtable's official MCP server lets AI assistants that support MCP, such as Claude and ChatGPT, read and write Airtable bases.
MCP permissions mirror the permission levels you have in Airtable; for example, commenter or read-only users can only read data.
airtable-mcp.who: Airtable users who want an assistant to work with their bases and records.
features: Read and write bases, tables and records

long: Amplitude MCP connects the Amplitude MCP server to AI tools so teams can query and create Amplitude content with natural language.
It is listed as freemium.
amplitude-mcp.who: Product and growth teams who want to ask analytics questions through an AI assistant.

long: Canva MCP connects AI assistants to Canva's design capabilities. Our listing notes creating, searching, editing and exporting designs.
Canva's documentation targets IT admins integrating Canva into internal tools and teams building AI assistants or platforms.
canva-mcp.who: Teams who want an AI assistant to create and manage Canva designs.
features: Create, search, edit and export designs
For AI assistants and internal tools

long: StackQL is an open-source engine that lets humans and AI agents query, provision and operate cloud and SaaS services with SQL, with no state file and no per-cloud SDK.
Its site lists providers such as AWS, Oracle Cloud, Databricks, OpenAI, GitHub, Datadog and Google Workspace, and offers an MCP server so agents can query live state across providers.
stackql.who: Platform engineers and agents that need one SQL interface across cloud and SaaS providers.
features: Query and provision cloud resources with SQL
No state file, no per-cloud SDK

long: Composio gives AI agents 1,000+ pre-authenticated toolkits, per-user sessions, authentication, triggers and a sandbox, so agents can turn intent into action.
The SDK monorepo includes a composio CLI to search, execute and script tools.
composio.who: Developers building agents that act across many apps on behalf of users.

long: E2B is open-source infrastructure for running AI-generated code in secure, isolated cloud sandboxes.
You start and control sandboxes with its JavaScript or Python SDK, using an API key.
e2b.who: Developers whose agents need to run generated code safely.

long: The GitLab MCP server lets you securely connect AI tools such as Claude Desktop, Claude Code and Cursor to your GitLab instance so they can access your GitLab data.
GitLab's docs list it as generally available on the Free, Premium and Ultimate tiers across GitLab.com, Self-Managed and Dedicated (GA since GitLab 19.5), with selectable toolsets.
gitlab-mcp.who: Teams on GitLab who want AI assistants to work with projects, issues and merge requests.
features: Works with GitLab.com, Self-Managed and Dedicated

long: Groq describes itself as a neocloud for fast inference: one integrated platform for infrastructure, inference and control.
Our listing notes it runs open models on custom LPU chips and is used for low-latency agents.
groq.who: Developers who need fast, low-latency inference for agents.

long: Linear MCP is Linear's official remote MCP server, documented in Linear's docs.
Our listing notes it lets agents find, create and update issues, projects and comments.
linear-mcp.who: Teams on Linear who want AI assistants to work with their issues.

long: Lune Research is an MCP server that grounds AI agents in full-text, top-tier computer science papers, cutting out hallucinated facts and noise from the open web.
It targets uses such as AI research, academic writing and literature review.
lune-research.who: Researchers and builders who want agents to cite real CS literature.

long: Manifold MCP is a hosted MCP server that connects Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor to live SEO, AI-answer, Reddit, social, ad and lead data.
It offers 250 free credits a month.
manifold-mcp.who: Marketers who want to research SEO, social and ads inside their AI assistant.

long: Modal is cloud infrastructure for teams that develop, train and serve AI applications at scale.
Its products include inference for serving LLMs, image and video models; our listing also notes serverless compute and sandboxes.
modal.who: AI teams who want serverless GPUs and sandboxes without managing infrastructure.

long: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open standard for connecting AI agents to tools and data. This repository holds the specification and documentation.
The schema is defined in TypeScript first and published as JSON Schema too; the official docs are on the MCP documentation website.
model-context-protocol.who: Anyone building MCP servers or clients.

long: New Relic's MCP server, part of New Relic Ground Truth, gives AI tools and agents governed access to New Relic operational intelligence.
MCP tools help organize observability data so agents can use it; our listing notes metrics, logs, traces and alerts.
new-relic-mcp.who: Engineering teams on New Relic who want agents to investigate incidents.
features: Part of New Relic Ground Truth

long: Notion MCP is Notion's official hosted MCP server; Notion's developer docs explain how MCP clients connect to your workspace.
Our listing notes agents can search, read and update pages and databases.
notion-mcp.who: Notion users who want an AI assistant to work in their workspace.

long: Recall.ai is an API for getting transcripts, recordings and metadata from meetings, and the infrastructure behind many meeting-recording products.
It captures each person's audio separately so transcripts show who said what, even when people talk over each other.
recall-ai.who: Developers building meeting bots or note-takers for Zoom, Meet and Teams.
features: Meeting bots for Zoom, Meet and Teams

long: Self Agent Vault is a payment and login layer for AI agents. Agents fill checkout and sign-in forms with mock tokens, and real card numbers and passwords are swapped in inside an enclave the agent never sees.
Our listing notes spending caps, merchant allowlists and a kill switch.
self-agent-vault.who: People who want their agent to buy things or sign in without exposing real credentials.

long: Slash for Agents is a business-banking MCP server that lets AI agents create cards, set spend controls and send payments.
Slash cites RSA-encrypted card data, human-in-the-loop approval and full Slash API access, available to all Slash users.
slash.who: Businesses on Slash who want agents to handle spending under controls.

long: Smithery connects agents to thousands of tools and services, handling auth, credentials and sessions for you. Our listing describes it as a registry for finding and installing MCP servers.
Smithery has announced it is now part of Arcade.dev.
smithery.who: Developers looking for MCP servers to plug into agents.

long: Together AI calls itself the AI Native Cloud, an AI cloud for running, fine-tuning and serving open models.
Its site highlights an open-source AI stack (models, inference, routers, harnesses and tools) and on-demand B200 GPUs.
together-ai.who: Developers who want to run or fine-tune open models in the cloud.

long: TollBit lets publishers create an agent-optimized version of their website for autonomous visitors.
Publishers can control access, analyze AI bot traffic and monetize their site by charging agents and bots for content.
tollbit.who: Publishers who want to control and charge for AI access to their content.

long: Vercel MCP is Vercel's official remote MCP server with OAuth, at mcp.vercel.com, giving AI tools secure access to your Vercel projects. It is available on all plans.

It lets assistants search Vercel docs, manage projects and deployments, analyze deployment logs and query analytics. Only clients reviewed by Vercel can connect, and the connection has the same access as your Vercel account.
vercel-mcp.who: Vercel users who want coding agents to manage and debug deployments.

long: Wolfram MCP is Wolfram's official MCP service giving any MCP-compatible application computed, verified answers via Wolfram Foundation Tool technology.
There are local self-managed, cloud and enterprise options.
wolfram-mcp.who: Developers whose agents need reliable computation and data.

long: Browser Use is an open-source browser agent library that lets AI agents control a web browser. You can run it locally with any LLM or on Browser Use Cloud.
Its README cites tasks like finding a slot and booking a driving test, and stealth cloud browsers.
browser-use.who: Developers building agents that complete tasks on websites.

long: Crawl4AI is an open-source web crawler and scraper that turns any website into clean, LLM-ready Markdown for RAG, AI agents and data pipelines.
You can run it yourself free or use its hosted option.
crawl4ai.who: Developers feeding web content to LLMs and RAG systems.

long: Chrome DevTools MCP lets coding agents such as Antigravity, Claude, Cursor or Copilot control and inspect a live Chrome browser.
It runs as an MCP server, giving assistants the power of Chrome DevTools for debugging and performance work.
chrome-devtools-mcp.who: Web developers who want agents to debug and profile in a real browser.

long: TARS is ByteDance's multimodal AI agent stack, shipping Agent TARS and UI-TARS-desktop.
Agent TARS brings GUI agents and vision to your terminal, computer, browser and product, mainly through a CLI; UI-TARS-desktop is a desktop app for controlling computers.
ui-tars-desktop.who: Developers exploring open-source GUI and computer-use agents.

long: Playwright MCP is Microsoft's MCP server providing browser automation with Playwright.
It lets LLMs interact with web pages through structured accessibility snapshots, without screenshots or vision-tuned models.
playwright-mcp.who: Developers giving agents reliable browser control.

long: OpenCLI converts websites into CLI commands and runs Browser Use on your logged-in Chrome.
It turns websites and browser sessions into deterministic interfaces for humans and agents, or lets you navigate, fill forms, click and extract on any page.
opencli.who: Developers who want agents to use websites through commands.

long: Cua is open-source infrastructure that gives AI agents computers they can use. Cua Spaces gives agents full desktops on your Mac and machines you own.
The repo also holds Cua Driver for desktop automation, Lume for local VMs, CUA-S1 decision models and Cua Bench for evaluating computer-use agents.
cua.who: Developers building and benchmarking computer-use agents.

long: Page Agent, from Alibaba, is a GUI agent that lives in your web page: one script gives any page its own AI agent.
It runs as in-page JavaScript, with no browser extension, Python or headless browser, and no screenshots.
page-agent.who: Web developers who want to add an agent to their own site.

long: Stagehand, from Browserbase, is a browser automation framework mixing code with natural-language actions.
It offers familiar Playwright-style methods such as goto, click, locator and screenshot, plus accessibility-tree trimming for agents; local runs need Chrome.
Browser Harness, from the Browser Use team, lets Claude Code, Codex or Cursor use your real Chrome browser: open pages, click, type, read and download, logged in as you.
You set it up by pasting one prompt into your coding agent; it talks to Chrome over the DevTools Protocol.
browser-harness.who: Coding-agent users who want them to act in their own browser.
features: Works with Claude Code, Codex and Cursor

long: Maxun is an open-source web data platform for real-time scraping, crawling, search, monitoring and AI data extraction.
Our listing notes no-code robots that turn websites into structured APIs.
maxun.who: Teams who need web data without writing scrapers.

long: ego lite is a browser where you and your AI agents work in parallel: agents run tasks in their own Spaces, isolated workspaces in the same browser, while you keep browsing.
Our listing notes it is a free macOS browser that works with Claude Code or Codex and reuses your logged-in sessions through an agent skill.
ego-lite.who: Mac users who want coding agents to automate web tasks next to them.
features: Works with Claude Code and Codex

long: Nanobrowser is an open-source AI agent that works in your own browser as a Chrome extension.
You give it a task in the side panel; it reads pages, clicks, types and moves between tabs, and asks before it submits.
nanobrowser.who: People who want an open-source agent to automate web tasks in Chrome.

long: BrowserOS is a free, open-source second browser just for your AI agents, with everything running on your machine.
You can import Chrome logins in one click, connect Claude Code, Codex or any MCP agent, and let agents run in parallel tabs while you watch live or replay.
browseros.who: People who want agents to handle web tasks locally.

long: Agent-S, from Simular, is an open-source computer-use agent that operates a real GUI, with mouse, keyboard and screen, as a person does.
Its README reports top OSWorld results, including Agent S3 as first to surpass human performance on OSWorld (72.6%).
agent-s.who: Researchers and developers building computer-use agents.

long: Google ARTEMIS lets AI assistants and test suites use real Android phones like a human.
It executes testing workflows and everyday tasks across apps from natural-language instructions.
google-artemis.who: Developers and testers automating Android apps.

long: Magentic-UI is an agentic application from Microsoft; its next generation, MagenticLite, pairs an on-device-friendly orchestrator model (MagenticBrain) with a browser-use model (Fara).
Our listing describes it as an experimental human-in-the-loop agent working across the browser and local files.
magentic-ui.who: Researchers and developers experimenting with human-in-the-loop agents.

long: Mobilerun is an open-source framework for controlling Android and iOS devices with LLM agents.
It gives agents mobile-native tools to inspect UI state, understand screenshots, tap, swipe, type and plan multi-step workflows, through a CLI or Python API.
mobilerun.who: Developers automating mobile apps with agents.

long: Steel is an open-source browser API for AI agents and apps, so you can build web agents without building automation infrastructure from scratch.
It also has a hosted cloud.
steel.who: Developers running browser agents at scale.

long: agent-device, from Callstack, provides mobile app automation and verification for AI coding agents on iOS and Android.
Agents get a live app feedback loop to inspect, control, debug and verify changes through a CLI, built-in MCP server or typed Node.js API.
features: Verify changes in the running app

long: Playwright Skill is an Agent Skill that lets coding agents write and run Playwright automation on the fly, from simple page tests to complex multi-step flows.
It is also packaged as a Claude Code plugin.
playwright-skill.who: Developers who want coding agents to test and automate web apps.

long: TuriX CUA lets AI models take hands-on actions directly on your desktop.
It ships a computer-use agent that its makers say reaches 80% success on their OSWorld-style Mac benchmark.
turix-cua.who: People who want an agent to operate desktop apps.

long: Spider is a fast web crawler and scraper written in Rust, built for concurrency.
It streams pages as they arrive, renders JavaScript only where needed, and scales from one script to a distributed fleet without code changes.
spider.who: Developers collecting web data for agents and LLMs.

long: Unbrowse turns websites into APIs agents can call by using the first-party APIs sites already use to talk to their backends.
The makers say this makes agentic browsing 50-100x faster and 95% cheaper than driving a browser. This repo is the open-source client for the hosted service.
unbrowse.who: Developers who want agents to use websites quickly and cheaply.
features: Faster than browser automation (per the maker)

long: Anchor is a cloud-hosted browser that lets AI agents use the web like a human, in secure, authenticated environments for navigating pages, submitting forms and extracting data.

Our listing describes Action Index as a shared memory of web workflows: agents replay proven paths as deterministic code, and the model only steps in where a page changed, via Anchor's MCP server and REST API.
anchor-action-index.who: Teams running computer-use agents on repeated web workflows.

long: Arro is an AI assistant for your computer that walks you through tasks like signing a PDF, books meetings for you and repeats chores once you've shown it.
It is free for Windows and Mac.
arro.who: People who want help with repeated tasks on their computer.

long: Browserbase offers cloud browsers for agents to use the web, plus managed browser agents.
It also provides search to find relevant sites and fetch to retrieve web data as agent-ready HTML, JSON or Markdown.
browserbase.who: Developers running headless browsers for agents at scale.

long: Holo4 is H Company's family of open-weight computer-use models, released Oct 1, powering generalist computer-use agents.
H Company is an AI research lab and agentic platform; our listing notes 27B and 35B-A3B sizes.
holo4-h-company.who: Researchers and developers building computer-use agents on open weights.

long: OpenSwarm describes itself as an AI desktop for Mac ("everyone gets a Jarvis now"); our listing calls it an AI-first operating system where swarms of agents run apps and browsers in parallel.
Its site says it is 100% free and offers early access through a waitlist.
openswarm.who: Mac users who want many agents working on apps and browsers at once.

long: Skyvern automates browser-based workflows using LLMs and computer vision.
It provides a Playwright-compatible SDK that adds AI on top of Playwright, plus a no-code workflow builder.
TinyFish provides enterprise infrastructure for AI web agents that run across hundreds of websites at once to navigate, authenticate, extract data and automate workflows.
It uses a fully serverless architecture and also offers TinyFetch, which turns a rendered page into clean data in one call.
tinyfish.who: Enterprises that need web agents at scale.

long: Agent-Reach is a toolkit that lets an AI agent read and search sites like X, Reddit, YouTube and GitHub, without paid APIs.

Its README (in Chinese) explains that each platform has its own hurdles, such as paid APIs, blocking, logins and messy data, and Agent-Reach bundles the tooling and tracks platform changes. For some sites it relies on content or browser sessions you export or control yourself.
agent-reach.who: Agent builders who want their agents to read social and developer sites.
features: Read and search X, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub

long: DeerFlow (Deep Exploration and Efficient Research Flow) is ByteDance's open-source long-horizon agent harness.
Our listing notes it researches, codes and creates using sandboxes, memory and sub-agents; version 2 reached #1 on GitHub Trending in February 2026.
deer-flow.who: Developers building deep-research and long-running agents.

long: Vane is a privacy-focused AI answering engine that runs entirely on your own hardware.
It combines web knowledge with local LLMs (Ollama) or cloud providers like OpenAI, Claude and Groq, and answers with cited sources.
vane.who: People who want a self-hosted, Perplexity-style search with sources.

long: STORM (Synthesis of Topic Outlines through Retrieval and Multi-perspective Question Asking) is a Stanford system that writes Wikipedia-style articles from web research.
The project also released Co-STORM, and the knowledge-storm package supports models through litellm.
storm.who: Researchers and writers who want long-form, sourced articles.

long: GPT Researcher is an open deep-research agent for web and local research on any task.
It produces detailed, factual research reports with citations, with many customization options.
gpt-researcher.who: Anyone who wants automated, cited research reports.

long: DB-GPT is an open-source agentic AI data assistant that connects to your data, writes SQL and code, runs skills in sandboxed environments and turns analysis into reports.
db-gpt.who: Data teams who want an LLM assistant over their databases.

long: WrenAI is an open-source generative BI (GenBI) engine: your agents generate governed SQL, deploy dashboards and keep business definitions in Git across 22+ data sources.
Our listing notes a semantic context layer for governed text-to-SQL.
wrenai.who: Data teams who want agents to answer business questions accurately.

long: SurfSense is a free, open-source, air-gapped NotebookLM alternative: an AI agent that researches, transforms and edits your documents on your machine.
surfsense.who: People who want a private research notebook over their own sources.

long: Feynman is an open-source research agent that reads papers, searches the web, writes research drafts, plans experiments and cites claims.

It searches alphaXiv, Semantic Scholar, OpenAlex, arXiv, PubMed, bioRxiv, Crossref, Hugging Face and the web, and some workflows write a provenance file of sources used. It sends anonymous usage data (not prompts or content) to PostHog.
feynman.who: Researchers who want cited literature reviews and drafts.
features: Skills bundle for Codex and OpenCode

long: MiroThinker is a deep research agent and open models optimized for research and prediction.
Its README reports a score of 88.2 on the BrowseComp benchmark; MiroThinker-1.7 and 1.7-mini were released in March 2026.
mirothinker.who: Researchers and builders working on deep-research agents.

long: Deep Research uses AI "thinking" and "task" models with internet access to generate in-depth research reports in a few minutes.
Our listing notes it works with any LLM and exposes an API and MCP server.
deep-research-u14.who: People who want quick research reports with their own model choice.

long: OpenScience is an open-source AI workbench for scientific research. Give it a goal and it reads the literature, writes and runs code and experiments, and writes up its findings, with every step recorded.
Our listing notes skills and connectors for databases like PubMed, UniProt and arXiv.
openscience.who: Scientists who want an agent to run research end to end.

long: PipesHub is an open-source platform for connecting AI applications to knowledge stored across your company's systems.
It connects Slack, Google Drive, GitHub, Microsoft 365, Notion and 50+ other systems, so you can search across them and get cited answers.
pipeshub.who: Companies that want agents and search over internal knowledge.

long: Paper2Agent is a multi-agent system that turns research papers into interactive AI agents with minimal human input.
Our listing notes it converts a paper and its code into an MCP server and agent skills you can query and run.
paper2agent.who: Researchers who want to use a paper's methods through an agent.

long: MiroFlow is the official implementation of the MiroMind Research Agent Project, a fully open-source system for multi-step internet research on complex problems such as future event prediction.
Our listing notes a web UI and support for MiroThinker and other models.
ToolUniverse, from Harvard's MIMS lab, is a collection of scientific tools for AI scientist agents.
It can run as an MCP server or be used as a Python SDK (Python 3.10+), and an agent can guide you through setup, API keys and skills.
Anamap is an AI analytics agent that investigates conversion, activation and revenue changes using your data, release history and tracking checks.
It delivers findings by email or Slack.
anamap.who: Product and growth teams who want explanations, not just charts.

long: Bruin is an open-source, AI-powered data platform: data ingestion with ingestr, SQL and Python pipelines, quality checks, column-level lineage and orchestration.
It also includes an AI data analyst that answers in Slack, Microsoft Teams, Google Chat, WhatsApp, Discord, Telegram and more.
bruin.who: Data teams who want one open-source platform for pipelines and AI analysis.
features: AI data analyst in chat apps

long: Dashworks is an AI assistant that answers questions from your company's apps and knowledge.
It positions itself as agentic enterprise search that finds the latest data live rather than duplicating data into a separate index.
dashworks.who: Companies that want answers across internal tools.

long: Elicit is an AI research assistant that helps you synthesize evidence, understand a field, design programs and experiments, draft proposals and weigh tradeoffs.
Elicit says it is used by over 7 million researchers.
elicit.who: Researchers who need to find and summarize academic papers.

long: Exa is a search API for AI agents that need real-time web data, deep research and structured content from one endpoint.
Exa reports leading results on search benchmarks such as FRAMES and offers a free trial.
exa.who: Developers adding web search to agents.

long: Firecrawl turns websites into clean, LLM-ready data for AI agents. It is open source and available as a hosted service.
Firecrawl says it covers 96% of the web, including JavaScript-heavy pages.
firecrawl.who: Developers feeding web data to agents and RAG.

long: Google Deep Review is a Google Research multi-agent system for analyzing technical documents.

Google says it has been deployed across 16,000+ submissions at conferences including STOC, ICML, NeurIPS and ICLR; our listing notes it checks papers, design docs and legal or financial documents for logical gaps and unsupported claims.
google-deep-review.who: Researchers and reviewers checking technical documents.

long: Hebbia is an AI platform for finance, used by asset managers, investment banks, law firms and Fortune 500 companies.
Our listing notes it runs agents across large document sets.
hebbia.who: Finance and legal professionals working with large document sets.

long: Kater is an AI data analyst that answers business questions from your data warehouse.
It lets you build an executive data assistant with structured decision trees that deliver insights and next steps.
kater.who: Business teams who want answers from their warehouse without writing SQL.

long: Kuration AI builds your own B2B database from licence registers, trade shows, dealer locators, maps and PDFs, maintained by AI agents.
Prospects can be reached on email, LinkedIn and WhatsApp.
kuration-ai.who: Sales teams and distributors building niche prospect lists.

long: Querri is an AI data analyst that turns scattered, messy data into clear answers in plain English.
Querri says teams can be up and running in a day.
querri.who: Teams who want to ask questions of messy data without analysts.

long: Tavily is a real-time search engine for AI agents, with fast, secure APIs for web search and content extraction.
tavily.who: Developers adding search and extraction to agents.

long: MLflow is an open-source AI engineering platform for agents, LLMs and ML models.
It helps teams debug, evaluate, monitor and optimize production AI applications.
Arize Phoenix is Arize's open-source AI observability platform for experimentation, evaluation and troubleshooting.
It traces LLM application runtime and runs evaluations; for managed production workflows, Arize offers Arize AX.
arize-phoenix.who: Developers who want open-source tracing and evals.

long: Guardrails AI is an open-source framework for validating LLM inputs and outputs with configurable guardrails.
As of July 2026, validators are moving to standard PyPI packages, and Guardrails is discontinuing hosted remote inferencing (planned cutoff August 25, 2026).
guardrails-ai.who: Developers who need to validate and constrain LLM output.

long: AI-Infra-Guard (A.I.G) is an AI red-teaming platform from Tencent Zhuque Lab.
It combines agent scanning, AI infrastructure vulnerability scanning, MCP server and agent-skill scanning, and jailbreak evaluation.
ai-infra-guard.who: Security teams assessing agents and AI infrastructure.

long: Microsoft's Agent Governance Toolkit provides policy enforcement, identity, sandboxing and SRE for autonomous AI agents.
It is in public preview and may have breaking changes before GA.
agent-governance-toolkit.who: Teams putting autonomous agents into production.

long: Failproof AI provides observability and enforcement for every harness your agents run in: it can see what agents do and block actions.
It hooks 12 agent harnesses, including coding CLIs like Claude Code and Codex, chat gateways and self-hosted assistants.
failproof-ai.who: Teams who need oversight and policy controls on agents.

long: Agenta is an open-source workspace where you build specialized agents that automate and augment your work, by chatting.
You can share agents with your team and talk to them in Slack, WhatsApp or Telegram. Our listing also notes prompt management, evaluation and observability.
agenta.who: Teams building and sharing AI agents.

long: TruLens finds where your agent fails and where you can cut cost without losing quality. It is open source and OpenTelemetry-native.
You instrument an app with a decorator, score each step with LLM judges that explain themselves, and compare versions.
Snyk Agent Scan discovers and scans agent components on your machine, including agents, MCP servers and skills, for prompt injections and vulnerabilities.
It installs via uvx or as a standalone binary; there is no npm package.
snyk-agent-scan.who: Developers and security teams checking their agent setup.

long: OpenLIT is an open-source platform to trace, evaluate, guard and improve AI agents and coding agents with OpenTelemetry.
It covers agent observability, evals, guardrails, prompt management and cost and GPU monitoring, and is free to self-host (Apache 2.0).
openlit.who: Teams who want open-source agent observability.

long: Agent Memory Leaderboard (AML) is an open, unified and reproducible evaluation platform for measuring how well long-term memory systems work for agents.
It runs a public leaderboard, challenges and open submissions; our listing notes it is run by a group of universities and labs in recurring rounds.
agent-memory-leaderboard.who: Researchers and builders comparing agent memory systems.

long: Galileo Agent Leaderboard is an evaluation framework for AI agents across real-world business scenarios.
v1 ranks tool-calling performance; v2 adds synthetic dataset generation and a simulation engine for task completion.
galileo-agent-leaderboard.who: Teams choosing LLMs for agent use.

long: AgentOps is an observability and DevTool platform for AI agents that helps developers build, evaluate and monitor agents from prototype to production.
The AgentOps app is open source under the MIT license.
agentops.who: Developers monitoring agent behavior and cost.

long: Basalt captures customer behavior so your AI agent can improve from it, building infrastructure for self-improving agents.
basalt.who: Teams who want their production agents to learn from real interactions.

long: Braintrust is an AI observability platform for tracing production, running evals and catching regressions before they reach users.
braintrust.who: Teams shipping AI products who need evals and monitoring.

long: Hamming AI is a QA platform for voice and chat agents: it auto-generates test scenarios, replays production calls and tracks 50+ metrics.
It covers testing before launch, red-teaming and monitoring every production call, and says it is SOC 2 certified.
hamming-ai.who: Teams building voice and chat agents.

long: Helicone is an open-source AI gateway and LLM observability platform for AI engineers.
Its gateway gives access to 100+ models with one API key through the OpenAI API, with routing and automatic fallbacks.
helicone.who: AI engineers who want observability and a model gateway.

long: Langfuse is an open-source LLM engineering platform that helps teams develop, monitor, evaluate and debug AI applications together.
It can be self-hosted in minutes, with a paid cloud as well.
langfuse.who: Teams building LLM apps who want open-source tracing and evals.

long: LangSmith is LangChain's platform for tracing, evaluating and monitoring LLM apps and agents.
The Python client nests every LLM call in a pipeline under a single trace in the LangSmith UI.
langsmith.who: Developers who need visibility into LLM apps, with or without LangChain.

long: Respan is an AI router with built-in observability and automated evals.
You point the SDK you already use at one endpoint to reach 1,000+ models, with automatic fallbacks, response caching and spend limits.
respan.who: Teams running LLM apps who want routing plus observability in one place.

long: Token Security secures non-human and AI agent identities.
Its site lists use cases including shadow AI and MCP server discovery, AI agent ownership and accountability, agent access control and right-sizing, and traceability across multi-agent systems.
token-security.who: Enterprise security teams governing AI agent identities.

long: Weave is Weights & Biases' toolkit for tracing and evaluating AI agents.
Conversations, turns, LLM calls and tool calls show up in an Agents tab, and you can trace your own functions with @weave.op.
Zenity lets you decide exactly what your AI agents can and can't do, evaluating every agent action in real time and steering it.
It positions itself as one platform for securing long-horizon AI agents.
zenity.who: Enterprise security teams overseeing AI agents.

long: Pipecat is an open-source Python framework for building real-time voice and multimodal conversational agents, from a single voice agent to a full multi-agent system.
TEN is an open-source framework for real-time multimodal conversational AI.
Its examples include a low-latency, real-time voice assistant over RTC or WebSocket that you can extend with memory and voice activity detection; our listing also notes the TEN Agent demo.
Vision Agents, from Stream, is an open framework for multimodal AI agents that watch, listen and understand video.
It provides building blocks for low-latency video experiences powered by your choice of models.
vision-agents.who: Developers building real-time voice and video agents.

long: Dograh is an open-source, self-hostable alternative to Vapi and Retell for building production voice agents with a visual workflow builder.
You can test agents in minutes, and AI coding assistants can help design and edit them through MCP.
dograh.who: Teams who want a self-hosted voice-agent platform.

long: Vocode is an open-source library for building voice-based LLM apps in minutes.
It supports real-time streaming conversations with LLMs that you can deploy to phone calls and apps.
Vexa provides open-source meeting bots and real-time transcription, in the cloud or fully self-hosted.
A bot joins Google Meet, Microsoft Teams and Zoom calls and streams speaker-attributed transcripts in real time through its API.
vexa.who: Developers building meeting transcription into their products.

long: VoiceMode enables natural voice conversations with Claude Code and other MCP-capable agents.
The maker's point: voice isn't about replacing typing but being available when typing isn't.
voicemode.who: Developers who want to talk to their coding agent.

long: TryVoice is a hands-free voice runtime for AI agents, so you can talk to your coding assistant without touching the keyboard.
It wraps agents like OpenClaw and Claude Code in a voice interface with wake-word activation and push-to-talk.
tryvoice.who: Developers who want hands-free control of coding agents.

long: Cicero is a self-hosted voice interface for coding agents: you speak, it answers out loud, and your agent does the work.
You install it next to your existing agent and talk to it from a browser; our listing notes Claude Code, Codex, ACP and Telegram calls.
cicero.who: Developers who want to talk to their coding agent remotely.

long: Voiceloop is a zero-dependency JavaScript library for a fast, interruptible voice-agent loop in the browser.
A live demo runs in your tab with no keys or install; our listing notes VAD, speech-to-text, LLM and text-to-speech stages.
voiceloop.who: Web developers adding voice agents to pages.

long: ClawCall is an AI that makes phone calls for you: it dials US numbers, works the menu, waits on hold and talks to the rep.
It offers 30 free calls and 30 minutes to start.
clawcall.who: People who want to skip phone menus and hold times.

long: Convai builds conversational AI for virtual worlds, enabling spatially aware 3D characters.
Our listing notes voice-enabled characters and agents that perceive, speak and act inside games and 3D scenes.
convai.who: Game and 3D developers adding AI characters.

long: Deepgram offers speech-to-text, text-to-speech and voice agent APIs for real-time enterprise voice solutions.
It cites text-to-speech latency as low as 80 ms.
Dial gives your AI agent a real phone number with calls, SMS, iMessage and WhatsApp through one API, with global reach.
dial.who: Developers whose agents need to call or message people.

long: ElevenLabs is a voice AI platform with a voice generator and voice-agents platform.
It offers 17,500+ voices in 90+ languages with secure APIs and SDKs.
elevenlabs-agents.who: Creators and developers who need lifelike speech or voice agents.

long: Inworld provides real-time voice models and open LLMs on a fleet it operates, for consumer apps.
It cites first audio as low as 50 ms, voice across four regions and LLM inference in the US.
inworld.who: Developers building interactive voice and character experiences.

long: LiveKit Agents is a framework for building realtime, programmable participants that run on servers, for conversational, multimodal voice agents.
It sits on LiveKit's real-time voice and video infrastructure; a JS/TS version, AgentsJS, is also available.
livekit-agents.who: Developers building real-time voice and video agents.

long: Retell AI is a platform to build, update, test and deploy AI voice agents.
Businesses use it to run phone agents for operations and customer service.
retell-ai.who: Businesses automating phone calls and support.

long: Simple Phones answers your business calls with a customized AI voice agent that you can keep tweaking to handle edge cases.
It also supports outbound calling for follow-ups.
Thoughtly provides AI voice agents that respond to leads in seconds, answer questions, qualify leads and book meetings automatically.
It cites a customer handling 20,000 calls a day.
thoughtly.who: Businesses handling inbound and outbound call volume.

long: Vapi is a platform for developers to build, test and deploy voice AI agents in minutes.
OpenClaw is an open-source AI assistant that runs on your own computer and meets you in channels you already use, such as Discord, iMessage, Slack, Teams and Telegram.
openclaw.who: People who want a self-run personal agent reachable by chat.

long: Career Ops is an open-source job-search agent: paste a job and, on your machine, it tells you if it's still open and whether it fits.
Our listing notes it scans job boards and scores postings against your CV; the maker says he built it for his own search and got the job.
career-ops.who: Job seekers who want help filtering and tailoring applications.

long: AnythingLLM is an all-in-one AI app to chat with your docs and use AI agents, multi-user and hyper-configurable, with no frustrating setup.
It is available for desktop (Mac, Windows and Linux) and as a server.
anythingllm.who: People and teams who want a private AI workspace over their documents.

long: Cherry Studio is a desktop client that supports multiple LLM providers, on Windows, Mac and Linux.
A mobile app is also available for iOS and Android; our listing notes autonomous agents and hundreds of assistants.
cherry-studio.who: People who want one desktop app for many AI models.

long: nanobot is an ultra-lightweight, open-source, self-hosted personal AI agent framework in Python.
You can use it in a browser, terminal or chat app to work with files, remember preferences and schedule tasks.
nanobot.who: Developers who want a small, hackable personal agent.

long: CowAgent is an open-source AI assistant that plans tasks, controls your computer and external services, creates and runs Skills, and builds a personal knowledge base and long-term memory.
It can also form multi-agent setups and connect to chat apps.
cowagent.who: People who want a self-hosted assistant across chat apps.

long: QwenPaw is a personal AI assistant you can deploy locally or in the cloud, extend with Skills and Plugins, and connect across channels.
It supports automation and scheduled recurring tasks.
qwenpaw.who: People who want a personal assistant on their own setup.

long: AionUi is a free, open-source cowork app with AI agents: a built-in agent with zero setup, any API key, multi-agent support, remote access and 24/7 automation.
Our listing notes it gives a GUI to CLI agents like Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode.
aionui.who: People who want a desktop GUI for CLI coding agents.

long: NanoClaw is a lightweight AI assistant that runs agents securely in their own containers, built to be easy to understand and customize.
Setup can provision each agent its own Slack app; our listing notes WhatsApp, Telegram and Slack.
nanoclaw.who: Developers who want a small, container-isolated personal agent.

long: agenticSeek is a 100% local alternative to Manus AI: a voice-enabled assistant that browses the web, writes code and plans tasks while keeping all data on your device.
agenticseek.who: People who want a private, local autonomous agent.

long: Screenpipe continuously records computer work (screen and audio) locally to map workflows, find work worth automating and give agents context.
screenpipe.who: Individuals and companies who want agents with context from computer history.

long: Kortix (Suna) is an open-source platform for agents that deliver finished work such as reports, decks, code, replies and deployed changes.
It pitches itself as an open-source alternative to Claude Cowork and ChatGPT Work.
kortix-suna.who: Teams who want self-hostable general-purpose agents.

long: Rowboat is an open-source personal AI assistant with built-in docs, whiteboard and email that works solo or with your team.
It indexes your work into a living knowledge graph and uses it to get work done on your machine.
rowboat.who: People and small teams who want an AI coworker with memory.

long: Leon is an open-source personal assistant that runs on your own server.
It is currently focused on a 2.0 Developer Preview, and the new documentation is not ready yet.
leon.who: Developers who want a self-hosted assistant to tinker with.

long: Eigent is an open-source cowork desktop app for building, managing and deploying a custom AI workforce that automates complex workflows.
It is built on CAMEL-AI and runs a multi-agent workforce in parallel, with customization and privacy protection.
eigent.who: People who want multi-agent automation on their desktop.

long: GenericAgent is a minimal, self-evolving autonomous agent framework: about 3K lines of seed code, 9 atomic tools and a ~100-line agent loop.
Our listing notes it grows its own skill tree for full system control.
genericagent.who: Developers interested in small, self-improving agents.

long: Moltworker runs the OpenClaw personal AI assistant (formerly Moltbot) in a Cloudflare Sandbox.
It is an experimental proof of concept.
moltworker.who: Developers who want to run OpenClaw on Cloudflare.

long: Octop, from Tencent Cloud, is an open-source, self-hosted AI assistant that is multi-user and multi-agent, able to work in parallel.
octop.who: Teams who want a shared, self-hosted assistant.

long: Yao puts all your agents and workspaces in one place, on every device you own, with tasks tracked on a board.
It is accessible from desktop, mobile, browser or API, and self-hosted.
yao.who: People running many agents who want to track their work.

long: Osaurus provides agents, memory, tools and identity that live on your Mac, built purely in Swift, fully offline and open source.
osaurus.who: Mac users who want a native, offline agent harness.

long: Big-AGI is a multi-model AI workspace for experts such as engineers, founders and researchers.
This repo is its open-source foundation; our listing notes personas, multi-model chats and agent features.
big-agi.who: Power users who compare and combine models.

long: OpenBot, from CopilotKit, is an AI assistant your company can own: same shape as ChatGPT, Claude or Grok, but running on your infrastructure, and you can change anything about it.
Our listing notes each AI coworker gets its own computer with a browser, files and tools.
openbot.who: Companies who want a self-owned AI assistant.

long: Everywhere ("Your AI - Everywhere") is an open-source desktop assistant built with .NET and Avalonia.
Our listing notes it sees what is on your screen and helps using LLMs and MCP tools.
everywhere.who: Desktop users who want context-aware AI help in any app.

long: Kun is a desktop app that runs on your computer: code, documents and agent conversations share one local runtime, and sessions, memory and settings stay on your machine. You connect your own model.

Its README (in Chinese) also lists a plugin and skills marketplace (MCP/Skills), reminders and scheduled tasks, a terminal TUI and remote access from your phone; it supports OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs.
kun.who: People who want a local-first agent workspace for coding, writing and research.

long: LobsterAI, from NetEase Youdao, is an open-source desktop agent that can operate in your real working environment, including local files.
Our listing notes data analysis, slides, documents and web research.
lobsterai.who: Desktop users who want an agent to produce documents and analysis.

long: ChatOllama is an open-source agentic app for running AI agents with hosted or local models.
You set an API key for any provider you want to use.
chatollama.who: People who want an open-source chat app for local and hosted models.

long: Moltis is a secure, persistent personal agent server written in Rust.
Our listing notes sandboxed execution.
moltis.who: Developers who want a self-hosted, security-focused personal agent.

long: OpenPilot is an open-source AI agent harness for your laptop. Bring your own LLM API key and let an agent read, edit and run tools against a real folder.
You can optionally plug in TinyFish for live web search; our listing notes approvals for edits and commands.
openpilot.who: People who want a free local agent with any OpenAI-compatible model.
features: File edits and commands with approvals

long: AirJelly is an always-on desktop AI that watches your workflow, remembers everything and acts before you ask.
It keeps a timeline of what it observed across apps and auto-captures tasks.
airjelly.who: People who want a proactive assistant with memory of their work.

long: BOSS Console is a tiny OS for your always-on agents: create your own agent with real tools and chat with it.
boss-console.who: People who want to build and run always-on agents with a chat interface.

long: ClawApp, from Sahara AI, lets you build a team of always-on AI agents on your Mac, each with its own model, tools and limits. It runs OpenClaw for you.
It offers GPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok through one account and is free to download with no card needed.
clawapp.who: Mac users who want OpenClaw agents without self-hosting setup.

long: ClawSimple offers managed OpenClaw and Hermes Agent hosting for Telegram bots, with platform AI, managed search and server maintenance.
Higher plans include more AI credits and search/crawl headroom.
clawsimple.who: People who want a hosted OpenClaw or Hermes bot on Telegram.

long: Lutra is a productivity agent that connects your work apps, integrating with Outlook, Gmail, spreadsheets and docs.
Lutra also offers MintMCP for securely connecting enterprise data and apps to AI.
lutra-ai.who: People who want to automate work across their apps by chat.

long: Manus is an action engine that goes beyond answers to execute tasks, automate workflows and extend your reach.
Our listing notes it does research and tasks in a cloud computer.
manus.who: People who want a general-purpose agent to complete tasks for them.

long: Mixus offers email-based agents for legal work in email and Word.
Redlines, analysis, drafts and models come back with attorney-in-the-loop control.
mixus.who: Legal teams who want agent help with human review.

long: Ninja AI is an all-in-one AI assistant with research, coding and writing agents.
Its site describes long-running adaptive agents powered by proprietary and open-weight models, which can be deployed in a customer's own cloud account.
ninja-ai.who: People and teams wanting one assistant for research, coding and writing.

long: Paperclip is open-source orchestration for teams of AI agents: "If OpenClaw is an employee, Paperclip is the company."
It is a self-hosted Node.js app; our listing notes org charts, goals, budgets and approval gates across Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw and other harnesses.
paperclip.who: Teams running many agents who want structure and oversight.

long: DocsGPT provides open-source AI agents grounded in your docs: private, self-hosted and any model.
You can self-host in one command; a cloud version is also available.
docsgpt.who: Teams who want private document Q&A and agents.

long: holaOS is an agentic workspace where your apps and your agent sit side by side.
You shape it to fit how your company works, connecting the systems and chat tools you already run.
holaos.who: Companies who want a customizable agent workspace.
features: Apps and agent side by side

long: Tracecat is an open-source security automation platform for teams and AI agents.
It gives AI-native security teams one platform to build agents and automate cyber defense.
Sema4.ai is an enterprise AI agents platform; its open-source Actions project connects agents to systems.
The project started as Robocorp Action Server and is being migrated under the Sema4.ai organization.
sema4-ai.who: Enterprises building agents that act on business systems.

long: 11x provides digital AI workers for go-to-market teams.
Our listing notes an SDR agent that researches prospects and runs outbound, and a phone agent that handles calls; customers cite time saved on cadences, research and messaging.
Accordio AI adds the tools Claude is missing: track time, sign contracts, send invoices and get paid.
It is a free MCP connector for Claude, Claude Code and any agent, with no trial clock or card required.
accordio-ai.who: Freelancers and small businesses who run work through Claude.

long: Agently is an AI chief of staff that learns how your company runs from your connected tools, then handles work with your approval.
agently.who: Leaders who want routine work handled by an agent.

long: Agentplace lets you build AI agents that answer questions, book appointments, handle customer service and deliver services online.
AgentSDR is an open-source, self-hosted AI SDR: email sequences, LinkedIn campaigns and WhatsApp calls.
Its AI CRM classifies every reply and drafts the answer.
agentsdr.who: Sales teams who want a self-hosted outbound agent.

long: Ami, from AiSDR, is an AI go-to-market agent: give it your website and 20 minutes, and you get a targeted list and a live campaign.
Ami keeps working to fix what stalls and scale what works.
ami-by-aisdr.who: Companies that want outbound running quickly.

long: Appian is an enterprise platform for AI process automation that orchestrates AI agents, systems and people without replacing your systems.
Artisan automates outbound with an AI-first platform powered by AI employees, led by Ava, an AI BDR.
Ava 2.0 gives you control over outbound working alongside your team.
Brev understands execution across your company, connecting goals, meetings, metrics and updates to surface risk early.
It aims to save leaders hours spent chasing updates.
Clara is a face-to-face video AI SDR that engages website visitors in real time, qualifies leads and books meetings.
clara-ai-sdr.who: B2B companies turning site traffic into pipeline.

long: Close is a CRM with a built-in AI teammate that calls leads, qualifies prospects, books meetings and keeps the CRM up to date automatically.
close.who: Sales teams who want CRM plus an AI teammate.

long: Cockpit AI is one AI go-to-market team covering outbound, studio, paid, organic, lifecycle, sales and web, run by an agent called Mira and reported every Monday.
You talk to Mira; your people close.
cockpit-ai.who: Companies who want AI to run GTM work.

long: Cresta Deputy Agent is a long-running agent built for customer-experience operations that automates work from intent to completion.
Our listing notes it pauses for approvals or documents in back-office workflows.
Crewdle lets you hire 24/7 autonomous AI agents and teams for support, sales, bookkeeping and research.
You pay per task with no subscription, and get $10 of credit to start.
crewdle.who: Small businesses that want work done by agents on demand.

long: Crono is an AI sales execution platform where reps and AI agents work side by side: identify signals, prioritize accounts and run multichannel outreach.
Crono says it is used by 300+ B2B teams.
CustomGPT.ai lets businesses build custom GPTs, AI agents built from their own content, for customer experience and employee efficiency.
Our listing notes no-code building, citations and anti-hallucination controls.
customgpt-ai.who: Businesses wanting agents grounded in their content.

long: Dropzone AI provides AI SOC analyst agents for alert triage and threat hunting.
Its AI SOC analyst aims to show what happened, with evidence in hand.
Duckie provides AI support agents that resolve tickets end to end, learning from your knowledge base to respond 24/7.
Ema, a "Universal AI Employee", is an enterprise platform for building and deploying AI agents across roles and industries.
Gradient Labs builds AI agents for financial services, automating disputes, KYC, lending, customer support and the back-office work in between.
Hatz AI lets you build, deploy and manage secure AI agents and workflows across your organization.
It says it is SOC 2 Type 2 compliant and built for SMBs and MSPs.
Hiver is an agentic omnichannel customer service platform used by more than 10,000 teams.
It combines AI, cross-team collaboration, ticketing and workflows; our listing notes it works inside Gmail.
hiver.who: Support teams who want a helpdesk in Gmail with AI.

long: Fin is Intercom's AI customer agent, used by over 12,000 brands across the customer journey.
Kognitos is a neurosymbolic agentic AI platform that automates finance, AP, healthcare and IT workflows in plain English.
It focuses on handling exceptions, not just the happy path.
kōdlo finds prospects, tells you how to warm them up, and writes the offer and deck from your docs.
Lead discovery fills your campaigns and deep research prepares cited briefs. It has a Free plan with no card required; our listing notes an MCP server.
k-dlo.who: Sales people who want an agent for prospecting and outreach.
features: Offers and decks from your docs

long: Mindflow is a no-code and agentic automation and orchestration platform for enterprise cyber and IT professionals to automate mundane tasks and deploy AI agents at scale.
Moveworks is an AI assistant platform for your workforce to find answers instantly and automate tasks across business apps.
moveworks.who: Enterprises resolving employee IT and HR requests.

long: Payman deploys AI that executes real banking transactions, such as payments, transfers and account analysis, through voice or text on existing rails.
It offers full visibility, configurable controls and complete audit trails.
Prophet Security is an agentic AI SOC analyst for AI-driven triage and investigation that resolves alerts in seconds.
It also offers proactive threat hunting and visibility into detection coverage.
Riff is a platform for AI agents that understand your operations, act across your systems and work alongside your people, focused on industrial operations.
Siena builds AI agents for commerce that combine empathy with automation to give shoppers personalized support.
Our listing notes the Social Agent converts comments and DMs, moderates, resolves support and turns social conversations into insight; it is sold via demo.
siena-social-agent.who: E-commerce brands handling social and support conversations.

long: Simbian investigates every security alert to a verdict, acts in the tools you already own and improves every week.
It positions itself as self-improving defense against AI attacks.
Trig is an agent-powered workspace for account management and customer success.
AI agents onboard new accounts, drive expansions and re-engage accounts before they churn.
Wand describes itself as agentic labor infrastructure for governments and global enterprises, with systems that let AI agents collaborate alongside humans.
wand-ai.who: Large organizations managing a hybrid workforce of agents and people.

long: Dify is an open-source LLM app development platform whose visual interface combines AI workflows, RAG pipelines, agent capabilities, model management and observability.
It is available self-hosted or as a paid cloud.
dify.who: Teams building LLM apps and agents visually.

long: Langflow is a platform for building and deploying AI agents and workflows, with a visual authoring experience plus built-in API and MCP servers.
You can run flows locally, deploy them as an API or expose them as MCP servers.
langflow.who: Developers prototyping and shipping agent workflows.

long: Sim is a workspace to build, deploy and manage AI agents and workflows.
It connects 270+ integrations and has a desktop app for macOS 12+ that can point at a self-hosted deployment.
sim-studio.who: Teams building and monitoring agent workflows.

long: Activepieces is all-in-one AI automation, extensible through a type-safe pieces framework written in TypeScript.
Pieces contributed to Activepieces also become available as MCP servers.
activepieces.who: Teams automating workflows with AI agents.

long: MaxKB (Max Knowledge Brain) is an open-source platform for building enterprise-grade agents, integrating retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
Our listing notes knowledge-base assistants.
maxkb.who: Enterprises building knowledge-base assistants and agents.

long: Astron Agent, from iFlytek, is an enterprise-grade, commercial-friendly agentic workflow development platform.
It integrates AI workflow orchestration, model management and AI and MCP tool integration.
Unstract uses LLMs to turn unstructured documents (PDFs, images, scans) into structured JSON.
You define what to extract in natural language, then run it via APIs or ETL pipelines.
Nexent is a zero-code platform for auto-generating production-grade AI agents, built on harness-engineering principles.
It provides unified tools, skills, memory and orchestration.
nexent.who: Teams who want agents from plain-language descriptions.

long: PySpur lets AI engineers iterate on agents visually, which the makers say is up to 10x faster.
pyspur.who: AI engineers iterating on agent workflows.

long: Boomi is a single platform that integrates applications, APIs, data and AI agents.
Our listing notes Boomi AI agents and agent management.
boomi.who: Enterprises integrating systems and managing agents.

long: Cassidy is a no-code platform that lets non-technical teams build AI assistants and workflows trained on company knowledge.
It offers hands-on support for adoption.
cassidy.who: Teams adopting AI across the organization.

long: Jotform AI Agents let you build customer-service agents that respond instantly to customers, anytime.
Our listing notes agents built from forms and docs that answer via chat, voice and messaging. You can get started free.
jotform-ai-agents.who: Businesses wanting customer-service agents without code.

long: Lindy is an AI employee that connects to your tools, knows about your company and does real work for the whole team.
lindy.who: Teams who want AI assistants for email, meetings and ops.

long: Make is a visual automation platform with AI agents, used from startups to global enterprises.
You can see your whole stack live, fine-tune with JavaScript or Python, and build and run automations from Claude.
n8n is a fair-code platform to build and deploy AI agents and workflows, combining a visual canvas with custom code.
You can run it self-hosted or in the cloud.
n8n.who: Technical teams automating workflows with AI.

long: Relevance AI lets you build specialist agents for sales, customer success, marketing and HR, and run millions of daily tasks on one platform.
SnapLogic is a governed integration platform that unifies people, apps, data and agents, positioned as the AI operational layer for the agentic enterprise.
Our listing notes AgentCreator for building enterprise agents.
Tray.ai is an AI-native enterprise iPaaS for building AI agents, governing MCP and integrating 700+ apps.
It includes an Agent Gateway for governed MCP.
Zapier Agents let you create custom AI agents in minutes, equip them with live business data and have them work across 8,000+ apps, on command or on a schedule.
zapier-agents.who: Teams who want agents across their business apps.

long: NocoBase is an open-source AI + no-code platform for building business systems fast.
Our listing notes AI employees inside the systems you build; a cloud option is available.
InsForge is an all-in-one, open-source backend platform for agentic coding.
Our listing notes it gives coding agents a database, auth and storage.
insforge.who: Developers using coding agents to build apps.

long: VibeSDK is Cloudflare's open-source, agentic platform for building and deploying full-stack applications on Cloudflare.
People build apps by working with an AI coding agent; you can run your own vibe-coding platform with it.
vibesdk.who: Companies wanting their own app-builder platform.

long: Bolt.new is an AI web development agent that lets you prompt, run, edit and deploy full-stack applications directly in the browser.
bolt.who: People building web apps from prompts.

long: v0 by Vercel is a collaborative AI assistant to design, iterate and scale full-stack web applications.
It generates working applications in minutes, with templates to start from.
v0.who: Developers and designers building web apps and UI.

long: OpenMontage is an open-source agentic video production system that turns your AI coding assistant into a video production studio.
Our listing notes ready pipelines and tools agents use to edit and assemble videos.
openmontage.who: Creators who want agents to produce videos.

long: MindsHub, from MindsDB, is an agent workspace for knowledge work and software development, with open-source agent harnesses and a choice of models.
Our listing notes a model router and a scoped vault for connected data.
Next AI Draw.io lets you draw and edit draw.io diagrams by chatting with an AI.
It is available as a web demo, desktop app and MCP server.
Teable turns your data into AI workflows and custom apps: data management, AI workflows and app building on one spreadsheet-simple platform.
teable.who: Business teams managing data and workflows.

long: The text-to-cad plugin gives your agent local workflows for generating 3D models as STEP, GLB, STL or 3MF files.
It also does design-for-manufacturing checks and generates engineering drawings.
text-to-cad.who: Engineers and makers using agents for CAD.

long: Presenton is an open-source AI presentation generator and API, positioned as an alternative to Gamma, Canva and Beautiful.ai.
presenton.who: People and developers generating slide decks.

long: InkOS is a story-creation AI agent system for novels, short fiction, scripts, interactive fiction and multilingual translation.
Its README (in Chinese) describes one workbench for serialized novels, short stories, screenplays, fan fiction, continuations, interactive games and long-form translation.
inkos.who: Writers using AI for long-form fiction.

long: GenOffice, from Genspark, is a free, open-source AI office suite: Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF files edited by you and your AI, saved in their real formats.
genoffice.who: People who want an open-source office suite with an AI agent.

long: Craft Agents, from the makers of Craft, is a desktop app for working with agents in a document-first way.
Our listing notes the agent sets up APIs and MCP servers for you and sessions can be shared.
CADAM is an open-source text-to-CAD web app: generate a CAD model in seconds in your browser, with no install.
It turns natural language and images into 3D models with parametric controls.
PPTAgent is an agentic framework for generating and refining PowerPoint presentations.
A PPTAgent Skill for Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode creates, revises and visually reviews editable decks.
pptagent.who: People generating slide decks with agents.

long: Circleback turns conversations into meeting notes, action items and searchable company knowledge.
It records and transcribes virtual and in-person meetings in 100+ languages; our listing notes automated follow-up workflows and integrations.
ExcaliClaw is a collaborative workspace for hand-drawn diagrams where you organize, search, share and create diagrams with Claude, Cursor and VS Code through MCP.
It is an independent workspace.
excaliclaw.who: People who diagram with AI assistants.
features: MCP for Claude, Cursor, VS Code

long: Sourcetable is an AI spreadsheet that analyzes data, builds financial models and generates Excel templates, graphs and reports.
It has connectors to bring your data in.
AI Town is a virtual town where AI characters live, chat and socialize.
It is a deployable starter kit for building your own version, inspired by the Generative Agents paper.
Voyager is an open-ended embodied agent with large language models that explores Minecraft on its own.
Our listing notes it writes and reuses code skills to learn as it goes; there is a paper on arXiv.
voyager.who: Researchers in embodied and lifelong-learning agents.

long: Mindcraft crafts minds for Minecraft with LLMs and Mineflayer: agents that play with you and take chat commands.
The maintainers warn not to connect it to public servers with coding enabled, since the LLM can write and execute code on your computer.
mindcraft.who: Players and researchers building Minecraft agents.

long: Wolfcha is an AI-native Werewolf game for deduction and bluffing that fills a complete table of distinct players.
You choose your role and LLM players take the other seats.
AI Dungeon is a free AI text adventure game where you create endless stories, explore worlds and direct every choice.
You can play online or in the app.
